svg.aria-label: Camera swap and why the stream resolution changes

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The 160° camera — swap it in, then raise the resolution

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 160° lens puts the whole room in frame, so the Switch screen lands on a much smaller slice of the sensor. That is fine — we scan

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: every 5 s, so frame rate is irrelevant and we simply take the pixels back by streaming at the sensor's full 1600 × 1200.

ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Photograph it first

svg.text: Seeed doesn't document which way the

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: contacts face — so photograph the stock

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ribbon while it's still seated.

svg.text: out with zero force. If it resists, the

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: latch isn't fully open.

svg.text: the way, then close the flap. Tug gently

svg.text: Why the resolution has to go up

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: what the 160° lens sees at 13 cm

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Switch screen

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ≈45% of frame

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the rest is your lap, the table, the wall

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The screen's diagonal subtends 72° of the lens's 160°.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: SVGA 800 × 600 — the old recommendation, wrong for this lens

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Screen lands on ≈360 × 270 px · a name banner ≈54 px wide · glyphs ≈7 px tall.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ML Kit needs roughly double that to read a name reliably — OCR would be guessing.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: SVGA was fine for a PHONE camera, where the screen fills most of the frame.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: UXGA 1600 × 1200 — use this

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Screen lands on ≈720 × 540 px · banner ≈108 px · glyphs ≈15 px. Preview sprites ≈90 px

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each, far above the matcher's 24 px descriptor. It costs frame rate — which we never use.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Swap BEFORE you collect any exemplars.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The local matcher learns from crops of your own confirmed photos, so teaching it through the stock lens stores the wrong distortion

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and scale. Flash with the stock camera to prove the toolchain, then swap the module, then start scanning.
